water.visual_evidence: Use spectral or texture contrast, surface continuity, and separation from surrounding land to identify water-covered regions.
water.mask_scope: Segment the visible water surface corresponding to the expression.
water.exclusion_rule: Exclude bridges, ships, roads, banks, docks, shore objects, and shadows unless they are explicitly the target.

vegetation.visual_evidence: Use green-tone canopy texture, patchy or continuous plant cover, and contrast with bare soil, pavement, or open water as supporting cues.
vegetation.mask_scope: Cover the vegetation area corresponding to the expression's referent.
vegetation.exclusion_rule: Exclude roads, buildings, shadows, water, cropland row patterns, and sports turf unless the expression names them as the target.

farmland.visual_evidence: Look for geometric field parcels, tillage or crop-row texture, and tonal contrast with forest, grass, or built surfaces.
farmland.mask_scope: Segment the farmland region corresponding to the expression.
farmland.exclusion_rule: Exclude farm buildings, tree lines, irrigation channels, roads, storage yards, and neighboring natural vegetation unless named as the target.

grassland.visual_evidence: Use uniform low-to-mid vegetation texture, gentle terrain context, and separation from dense forest, crops, or paved surfaces.
grassland.mask_scope: Cover the grassland area corresponding to the expression's referent.
grassland.exclusion_rule: Exclude scattered trees, trails, waterlogged patches, livestock pens, and adjacent cropland unless the expression specifies them.

forest.visual_evidence: Use dense canopy texture, irregular crown shadows, and high vertical structure relative to grass, crops, or bare ground.
forest.mask_scope: Segment the forest canopy and enclosed understory region corresponding to the expression.
forest.exclusion_rule: Exclude roads, clearings, buildings, power-line corridors, water, and isolated tree rows unless the expression marks them as the target.

bare land.visual_evidence: Use low vegetation cover, bright or dark soil tones, sparse texture, and contrast with green vegetation or smooth pavement.
bare land.mask_scope: Segment the bare land region corresponding to the expression.
bare land.exclusion_rule: Exclude thin roads, building footprints, shadows, seasonal water, and mixed transitional strips unless explicitly part of the referent.

river.visual_evidence: Use water continuity, channel context, and flow-like spatial layout as supporting evidence for river localization.
river.mask_scope: Segment the river water area corresponding to the expression.
river.exclusion_rule: Exclude bridges, banks, roads, boats, vegetation, docks, and nearby land objects from the river mask.

lake.visual_evidence: Use enclosed or semi-enclosed water bodies, shoreline loops, and relatively homogeneous interior water tone as supporting cues.
lake.mask_scope: Segment the lake water surface corresponding to the expression.
lake.exclusion_rule: Exclude piers, boats, islands, dams, surrounding roads, and shoreline vegetation unless the expression targets them explicitly.

bridge.visual_evidence: Look for a constructed crossing connecting separated transport or land regions across water, roads, railways, or gaps.
bridge.mask_scope: Segment the bridge structure corresponding to the expression.
bridge.exclusion_rule: Exclude connected roads, rivers, vehicles, shadows, piers outside the bridge body, and surrounding terrain.

road.visual_evidence: Use elongated paved or compacted surfaces, lane-like parallelism, intersections, and contrast with adjacent soil or vegetation.
road.mask_scope: Segment the road surface corresponding to the expression.
road.exclusion_rule: Exclude vehicles, sidewalks, parking stalls, bridges, runway strips, and building shadows unless named as the target referent.

building.visual_evidence: Use rectangular footprints, roof tone and material cues, cast shadows, and separation from roads, bare soil, or canopy cover.
building.mask_scope: Segment the building footprint and roof area corresponding to the expression.
building.exclusion_rule: Exclude attached parking, yards, trees, adjacent roads, and rooftop clutter unless the expression includes them as the target.

vehicle.visual_evidence: Use small bright or dark blobs on roads and lots, size cues versus lane width, and spacing patterns consistent with traffic objects.
vehicle.mask_scope: Segment each vehicle instance or the stated vehicle group corresponding to the expression.
vehicle.exclusion_rule: Exclude road paint, lane gaps, shadows, roof objects, and nearby pedestrians or structures unless the expression names them.

ship.visual_evidence: Use elongated hull shapes on water, deck contrast, wake or mooring context, and separation from piers and small boats if visible.
ship.mask_scope: Segment the ship hull and superstructure corresponding to the expression.
ship.exclusion_rule: Exclude wharves, buoys, waves, dock equipment, adjacent water outside the hull, and harbor infrastructure unless explicitly targeted.

airport.visual_evidence: Use large-scale paved areas, runway-like linear structures, apron zones, and aircraft-related infrastructure as grounding cues.
airport.mask_scope: Segment the airport region corresponding to the expression, whether it refers to the whole facility or a named sub-area.
airport.exclusion_rule: Exclude individual airplanes, adjacent highways, unrelated buildings, and surrounding terrain outside the airport extent.

parking lot.visual_evidence: Use flat paved panels, stall or bay markings, vehicle clusters, and adjacency to buildings or roads as supporting layout cues.
parking lot.mask_scope: Segment the parking lot paved area corresponding to the expression.
parking lot.exclusion_rule: Exclude drive aisles named as roads, sidewalks, building footprints, landscaped islands, and rooftop decks unless specified in the text.

playground.visual_evidence: Use bright synthetic turf or court paint, compact geometric layouts, and enclosure by fences or school blocks when visible.
playground.mask_scope: Segment the playground facility area corresponding to the expression.
playground.exclusion_rule: Exclude surrounding parking, roads, tree shade, sports stadiums, and building roofs unless the wording includes them as targets.

harbor.visual_evidence: Use basin-shaped water, pier alignments, breakwaters, moored vessels, and port structures contrasting with open sea tone.
harbor.mask_scope: Segment the harbor facility and sheltered water corresponding to the expression.
harbor.exclusion_rule: Exclude open ocean, unrelated coastal roads, distant ships, and upstream river channels unless the expression names those parts.
